summary: Cosan S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of purchase and sale agreements for the consensual segregation of land assets in Mato Grosso, Brazil. The transaction value is R$1.85 billion, of which approximately R$586 million represents Cosan's indirect interest. The purchasers are SLC Agrícola, Bom Futuro, and Alexandre Jacques Bottan, who exercised their right of first refusal. The board recommends the transaction. Closing is expected by October 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions precedent. This is an asset sale by the registrant. Watch for regulatory approvals and any competing bids; the risk-arb is minimal given consensual nature.
